title: A new home for your universe
summary: A clearer Play screen. More room for every update.

changes.text: A new home screen with a spacious illustration, a prominent Play button and game readiness at a glance.
Permanent Home, What's new and Settings navigation keeps everything within easy reach.
Search release notes by version, date or words from any change. Pick a release to read its full details.
Cleaner Settings for your game folder and installation choice, with troubleshooting tucked away until you need it.
More readable text, clearer selected and keyboard focus states, and layouts that scroll on smaller displays.
Use Ctrl+1 for Home, Ctrl+2 for What's new, Ctrl+comma for Settings, and Ctrl+F to search updates.

title: Your updates, in one place
summary: See what changed before you jump back into SPORE.

changes.text: Latest update highlights on the launcher's home screen.
A full release history with version numbers, dates and readable change lists.
Release notes are included with the launcher and stay available offline.

title: A simpler way to launch SPORE
summary: Open the launcher, press Play SPORE, and use your existing game and saves.

changes.text: Automatic detection of supported SPORE installations.
Play with your normal Windows account and existing saves. No separate profile or backup setup required.
Automatic compatibility checks before starting the game.
A redesigned home screen, with installation options and local support reports in Settings.
